profile.summary: VCS21 Software Architecture for five (5) core product components and Product Owner for the Reconfiguration sub-component. Please see VCS21 under Projects for details about the VCS21 project.

positions.title: Data Scientist/Lead Software Engineer
positions.description:
Technical lead and developer Digital Thread Data Infrastructure (DTDI) project at L3Harris.  Scope of position includes the following technologies and processes:
*   SQL stored procedures in Transact-SQL (T-SQL) using SQL Server Management Studio (SSMS).
*   Microsoft Business Intelligence (BI) platform using SQL Server Report Services (SSRS).
*   Multi-tenant, multi-level security using SQL Server Row-Level Security (RLS).
*   Extraction, transformation, and loading (ETL) processes within a multi-domain Data Mesh architecture for building digital threads.
*   Project database administrator: planning, execution and oversight of deployment process including data migrations to ensure smooth and efficient releases to production environments.
*   Scrum agile methodology consisting of sprint planning, execution and sprint review using JIRA toolset.  Baseline management using Bitbucket.
*   Communication of project status to stakeholders and leadership.
*   Oversight of data architecture, design, implementation, and deployment using best practices.

positions.title: Lead Software Engineer/Data Engineer
positions.description: Led data migration of 8k hardware assets into open-source asset mgmt. platform Open Audit using MySQL.  Extended system to include software asset and license mgmt..  Developed custom reports that drove the organization’s business process for runtime CMDB.  Hands-on with the following technologies: MySQL, phpMyAdmin, PHP, CodeIgniter MVC, Linux, Apache httpd, HTML, CSS, Javascript, AJAX, jQuery DataTables, and https/ssl.

positions.title: Software Integration Engineer
positions.description: Integrated 3 open-source tools (Nagios Core, Check_MK and ELK) to create a low-cost event mgmt solution scalable to 3,000 endpts. Configured active and passive monitoring (SNMP polling, JMS messaging & SNMP traps).  Designed a tier-consistent Service Model using a dependency tree pattern with configurable propagation rules.  Implemented the pattern with open-source Check_MK.  Developed a summary-level availability dashboard for mission impacts.

positions.title: Software Architect - Product Owner
positions.description: Product owner for Reconfiguration and Traffic Data Reduction and Analysis components, consisting of seven (7) team members.  Performed requirements analysis and system-level design for 17 features consisting of approx. 655 requirements.  Technologies used: Postgres, Splunk, Dream and Zabbix.

projects.title: VCS21
projects.description:
Harris VCS21™ is a global, next-generation Voice over Internet Protocol (VoIP) communication system designed for Air Traffic Management communications. Its network-centric approach, replaces proprietary, A/G frequency & G/G trunk communications hardware with standards-based, VoIP-enabled voice nodes, reduces dependency on traditional point-to-point communications. The product was generated from proven ATC Algorithms with over 18+ million systems hours of combined operation in more than 50 countries.

Some key features include:
Scalability to support one to 800+ controller working positions
Designed to exceed 0.999999 of network availability
ED-137 specification compliant
Lowers operating costs by reducing systems, spares, and integration
Supports dynamic re-sectorization, resource allocation, workload balancing, and airspace design

Additionally, VCS21™ allows net-centric and legacy voice systems to coexist, enabling a seamless transition during ATC modernization programs of virtually any size and complexity, from small, single-tower installations to national and multinational voice enterprise systems. The system operates as a fully networked voice enterprise, enabling enhanced capabilities for business continuity planning, asset sharing and future facilities.

The product was recently selected by the FAA to enable their National Airspace System Voice Switch (NVS) program.
